title: Resend an AGV Command to Geek+ Using the OptiSweep WCS API
summary: Use the OptiSweep / WCS API through Apidog to resubmit a Geek+ AGV request when the command GUID is available, then review GET command status for the associated main GUID. This is useful after an unplanned restart when Geek+ may have missed the request.
when_to_use: Use when an AGV command request may have been missed by Geek+ after an unplanned restart and a command GUID is available from the command database model or command status data.
not_for: Do not use when the required command GUID is unavailable.
Do not use as a physical AGV recovery or E-stop procedure.
Do not treat execution of the resend request as confirmation that Geek+ completed the command; the packet does not provide completion confirmation.

roles_and_responsibilities.responsibility: Use the WCS / Helix DB (SSMS) and OptiSweep / WCS API through Apidog to identify the command GUID, submit the Resend Geek Command request, and review GET command status.

safety_notes: Confirm that a command GUID is present before submitting the resend request.
Stop and escalate rather than attempting the resend when the command GUID is unavailable.
access_or_tools_needed: Apidog / WCS API client on the primary server
WCS / Helix DB (SSMS) for command database model or command status data

access_required: L2 support access to the OptiSweep / WCS API and Apidog.
L2 support access to the WCS / Helix DB (SSMS) when the command GUID must be obtained from command data.
system_preconditions: The command GUID is available from the command database model or AGV command status data.

steps.title: Open the Resend Geek Command request in Apidog
steps.purpose: Access the live OptiSweep / WCS API request used to resubmit an AGV command to Geek+.
steps.instruction: On the primary server, open Apidog / WCS API client and select the AGV request labeled "Resend Geek Command". Confirm that the related GET Get Agv Statuses request is available for status review.
steps.expected_result: The Apidog AGV request list displays POST Resend Geek Command and GET Get Agv Statuses.
steps.healthy_condition: The Resend Geek Command request is available in the OptiSweep / WCS API client.
steps.failure_condition: The required API request is unavailable or the OptiSweep / WCS API client cannot be accessed.

actions.label: Open AGV API requests
actions.exact_action: Select the AGV request labeled "Resend Geek Command" in Apidog.

stop_or_escalate_if: Escalate if Apidog or the OptiSweep / WCS API cannot be accessed.
Escalate if the Resend Geek Command request is not available.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: OptiSweep APIs provide data and make requests; Apidog is installed on the primary servers, and the AGV API list includes GET Get Agv Statuses and POST Resend Geek Command.
The API view lists Resend Geek Command and states that it requires a command GUID and resends the request to Geek+.

steps.title: Obtain and verify the command GUID
steps.purpose: Ensure the resend request has the identifier required to resubmit the AGV command.
steps.instruction: Review the command database model or AGV command status data in the WCS / Helix DB (SSMS) or the OptiSweep / WCS API. Locate the command GUID associated with the command. Confirm that the command GUID is present before continuing.
steps.expected_result: A command GUID is present for the AGV command selected for resend.
steps.healthy_condition: The command data exposes a non-missing command GUID that can be supplied to Resend Geek Command.
steps.failure_condition: The command GUID is missing or cannot be associated with the command being recovered.

actions.label: Inspect command data
actions.exact_action: Review the command database model or AGV command status data and confirm that a command GUID is present.

stop_or_escalate_if: Stop and escalate if the required command GUID is unavailable.
Escalate if the command data cannot identify the command GUID.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: Resend Geek Command requires a command GUID from the command database model.
The AGV status view includes commandGuid among the AGV command and status fields.

steps.title: Submit Resend Geek Command
steps.purpose: Resubmit the identified AGV command request to Geek+.
steps.instruction: In the OptiSweep / WCS API client, enter the verified command GUID into the "Resend Geek Command" request and execute the request. Do not submit the request if the command GUID is missing.
steps.expected_result: The Resend Geek Command request executes with the required command GUID and resends the request to Geek+.
steps.healthy_condition: The API client shows that the Resend Geek Command request was executed using the verified command GUID.
steps.failure_condition: The request cannot be executed, or the required command GUID is not accepted or available.

actions.label: Resend the Geek+ command
actions.exact_action: Provide the command GUID to the "Resend Geek Command" request and execute the request.

stop_or_escalate_if: Do not proceed if the command GUID is missing.
Escalate if the resend request cannot be executed.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: Resend Geek Command requires a command GUID and resends the request to Geek+; it is helpful after an unplanned restart when Geek+ missed the request.

steps.title: Review GET command status and main GUID
steps.purpose: Verify that command identity information is visible after the resend request.
steps.instruction: Open or review GET command status in the OptiSweep / WCS API client and inspect the returned command status information for the associated main GUID.
steps.expected_result: GET command status exposes the associated main GUID for the command.
steps.healthy_condition: The command status response contains the expected main GUID field or value associated with the resent command.
steps.failure_condition: GET command status does not expose the expected main GUID, or the command status cannot be retrieved.

actions.label: Review command status
actions.exact_action: Open or review GET command status information and check for the associated main GUID.

stop_or_escalate_if: Escalate if GET command status does not expose the expected main GUID.
Escalate if command status cannot be retrieved after the resend request.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: GET command status also shows the main GUID.
